purpose: Recorded selections for tools/prepare_museum_long_arm_media.py (museum_review face rebuild for floors.json).

provenance.ceiling_scope: Original named presets and replayed region selector lookup. Resource indices recorded; museum cache descriptors, pixels, UVs and lighting unverified.

limits: material_indices is the set of materials present in the 2026-09-13 runtime material capture; the builder textures a face only when its resolved material is in this set. The images themselves come from the published export.
ceiling_deferred are the regions whose ceiling selection the recorded native selector replays deferred; their standalone ceilings stay untextured (shell). Not re-derived.
review_fps is the recorded playback rate of animated captured materials (affects museum.json animations only).
